text:
jordan.r: Heads-up 10min HelioFlux agreed to a short case study + 15m follow-up quote. They can do video or audio. Need Qs + legal release.
lara_m: sweet. timezone: GMT+1 for their eng lead. i can do Tue 14:00 CET to accommodate.
jordan.r: locking Tue 2026-07-21 14:00 CET. can someone draft a tight question set and pull-quote prompts?
lara_m: will do. aim for 7 Qs, ask for benchmark artifacts or attestation. sending draft in 30m.

Draft Qs (lara_m):
```
1) quick intro: your role + how HelioFlux uses Redwood Inference
2) which model & sequence length did you benchmark? include job/run id if possible
3) baseline median latency vs current after migration (numbers + units)
4) any config highlights (batching, kv cache, quantization)
5) business impact: user metric or ops time saved
6) can you provide a short quote verifying the latency improvement? name/email for signoff
7) are there any compliance constraints or embargo windows?
Pull-quote prompts: one-sentence impact + metric + signoff
```

jordan.r: nice. legal-team: reminder 1) for any numeric claim we need either raw run logs/config or a signed attestation; 2) quote release signed within 72h after we send form.
legal-team: also flag: no PII/screenshots without redaction, and confirm logo use (svg).
ops-bot: (automated) provisional calendar created: Tue 2026-07-21 14:00 CET  invite pending acceptance. Recording disabled by default; enable only with explicit consent.
jordan.r: webinar ask: can HelioFlux join a 20m launch panel the week after publish? ask for an engineering speaker and a 3-slide summary.
lara_m: add localization: we need a single-sentence TL;DR for EMEA and a localized headline in German. they also want a short quote in German if possible.
jordan.r: routing: once published, route leads from the case page to AE East queue (ae-east) and mark priority enterprise. sam.ae can you confirm lead scoring?
sam.ae: yes, route to ae-east and set lead score 90 for immediate follow-up; i'll add nurture cadence.
design-squad: can you prepare a hero image + two social cards (1:1, 16:9) after quote signoff? need logo svg + headshot. delivery target 48h after signoff.
design-squad: noted. also request brand color from HelioFlux for the hero treatment.
jordan.r: timeline check: interview Tue, quote release signed by Fri (72h), legal signoff Fri evening, design ready Mon, publish Thu next week, panel Tue after that. tight but doable.
legal-team: we'll upload a compact quote-release template and an attestation form to this thread post-call. please ask customer to attach run id or sign attestation.
jordan.r: if we only get attestation we will label metrics "customer-reported" with a short methodology note.
lara_m: pinned checklist added: interview asset, quote signed, artifacts/attestation, headshots, localized TL;DRs, design, routing, embargo.
jordan.r: setting embargo date to 00:00 UTC on publish day. treat as confidential until then. i'll update with customer confirmations. :sparkles:
